newsitems.title: Flak Simulator Devlog | What’s Playable at Early Access Launch
newsitems.author: Gravelight
newsitems.contents: Flak Simulator launches in Steam Early Access on November 26, 2026. When a bomber formation appears, someone has to spot it, someone has to get ammunition to the gun, and the crew has to get a shot off before the formation passes. Sharing that work is what Flak Simulator is built around. What you’ll play at launch The launch lineup covers two locations and three scenarios. In co-op, you share the jobs around the battery. You can also play with AI crew, who fill any open positions at the guns. In Arcade, each player gets their own gun and plays for an individual score. Germany · Day and night Defend the battery with the 8.8 cm flak gun and the lighter 2 cm Flak 38. In the daytime mission, low-flying aircraft attack the battery while bomber formations head for key targets you’re defending. North Africa · Day In North Africa, tanks roll toward your position while air raids keep the battery busy. Here you’ll see the 8.8 cm gun in its desert finish. A closer look at the crews Here are studio renders of the two crew uniforms, from the grey Luftwaffe uniform in Germany to the tropical uniform in North Africa. Coming to Early Access · Convoy Escort In our upcoming Convoy Escort mode, your job is to protect a convoy on the move. You’ll use a 2 cm Flak 38 mounted on an Opel Blitz to defend the column from low-flying aircraft as it travels toward its destination. We’re also working on the 40 mm Bofors. Here’s a studio render of the gun in development. Once you’ve played, we’d like to hear where your crew found its rhythm and where things broke down. Tell us on our official Discord how aiming felt, which crew jobs needed clearer cues, and which attacks gave your battery the most trouble. That feedback will help us tune the game during Early Access. You can also find other players there to crew up with. Wishlist Flak Simulator on Steam and join us on November 26. — Horseman Interactive
